scope: UNSCORED task-balanced joint prompt/output shapes from 32 actual Terminal trajectories. This underweights long trajectories relative to the request-weighted source distribution; source and selected quantiles are both reported. Each task starts with its actual first call, then a three-call consecutive window where available; omitted intermediate calls are not replayed. Two tasks have only two calls. Synthetic prefixes therefore do not reproduce historical cache hits. Synthetic prompt IDs and fixed2s toolgap, not real task/tool replay or accuracy. Selected context shrink resets synthetic prefix after the recorded common prefix; real source cache starts are annotations, not guaranteed reproduced hits.

selection.algorithm: actual first call plus best of256 deterministic three-call windows by log-relative mean/quantile distance; require observed maxoutput and first contextshrink per affected task
